_comment: Copy to probes.json and edit. Each probe: a page URL, a case-insensitive
regex matched against the selection button's accessible name (run
`python3 probe.py --discover --url <URL>` to see the names on a page),
and an optional `nth` when the regex matches several buttons.
The stratification below is the point: one star prop, one bench prop,
a WNBA side and total, then NBA/NFL anchors — enough to see whether
FanDuel's max wager varies by market class and within WNBA props.
Keep the list SHORT. This runs against your real account.
